name: research-presentation

upstream.scope: Derived engineering approach; workflow and tooling rewritten for research and project reporting

changes: Scenario-specific content planning: group progress, paper sharing, academic and technical project reports
Per-slide question, main information, evidence, timing, speaker notes and visual purpose/source/readiness
Proactive image extraction, data plotting and schematic preparation guidance; generated illustrations cannot stand in for evidence
Static replacements for interaction/media and purposeful text-only exceptions
Local fixed assets, source-preserving editor with backup/conflict checks, browser checks of hidden pages and fragment states, print readiness before PDF

covers: Image plans must become actual placed visuals, not text markers
Real local editor saves, stale conflicts, origin/token, path/symlink containment and byte ranges
Real Chrome hidden-page overflow, blocked network/broken image, invalid formula, Mermaid sizing, slider/reset, audio seeking/time marker, complete HTML/PDF export

verification.browser: Locally installed Google Chrome via Puppeteer; external requests blocked for preview/render tests

demo.data: Deterministic labelled teaching data, synthetic audio and self-drawn SVGs; not actual research results

visual_review.notes: Reviewed full screenshots plus live/PDF contact sheets; corrected layout, code contrast/output, diagram readiness, media seeking and PDF readiness issues found during testing

verification.skill_validator: passed for new skill and system overview
verification.syntax_check: all authored JS scripts/runtime/tests passed node --check

limitations: Content checks validate records, presence and associations; they do not certify scientific truth, visual relevance, source permissions or speaking quality.
The synthetic demo tests the implementation, not whether every future agent will choose good images or organize research well.
Target projector, audience comprehension and other operating systems/browsers were not tested.
Third-party D3/Plotly/WebGL/map services are optional extensions, not automatically included or validated.
No actual external paper figure extraction or billable image generation was needed for this synthetic demo.
Global installed skills and historical distribution snapshots were not replaced.
